description: ICCA names the four separated roles that carry the method: Implementer, Checker, Control, Auditor. Mandatory development workflow for any task that changes production code, fixes a bug, adds a feature, performs a refactor, or creates a commit. MUST be loaded before implementation begins. Keeps the orchestrator's context lean (delegation to a cheaper implementer tier, index navigation, evidence ledger) and enforces Commit Contract, Red Proof, frozen acceptance tests, delegated implementation, independent verification, bounded repair loops, Commit Gate, and requirement-first audit via global hooks.
